user.title: Gdzie się ukryć
user.description: Download the complete PSP export, show nearby points on the HA map and calculate walking routes from selected zones. No API key or manual file required.

data.data_file: JSON path relative to HA configuration directory
data.nearby_limit: Points on the map and nearby list (per zone)

data_description.source_mode: Automatically downloads the full national PSP CSV export, checks it every 24 hours by default, and filters points locally. PSP declares weekly publication. The routing service receives origin and destination coordinates.
data_description.nearby_limit: Defaults to 100 nearest points in the radius, range 30–500. Does not limit the full dataset download or the count of all points in the radius.

error.too_few_candidates: Candidate count must be at least the route count.
error.invalid_url: Enter a complete HTTP/HTTPS URL without credentials.

abort.single_instance_allowed: Already configured. Add extra zones using integration options.
